entries.text: Podger and Brecon Baroque treat the violin concertos as chamber music — one to a part, directed from the violin. The ear hears lithe, polished playing and a sweet Andante in BWV 1041; the harpsichord-derived reconstructions fill a programme where only two solo concertos survive. This is chamber HIP Bach, not a phantom complete triad of 1041–1043. For that approach, this is the Référence.
